name: send_message
description: Send a message via Telegram, WhatsApp, Signal, SMS or any other configured messenger provider, to a Klacks client (default) or to an application user. ALWAYS call this directly when the user says 'send/schick' a message, even if no provider/channel is named — do not ask for confirmation, do not first check the provider list, do not ask which provider/channel to use before calling the skill; the skill itself resolves the provider automatically when only one is enabled. For recipientType 'client' (default): recipient values are 'mir' / 'ich' / 'me' / 'myself' (sends to the Klacks owner — looked up in Settings -> Owner-Messenger card), a contact name like 'Heribert' (looked up in the Mitarbeiter Messenger tab for the requested provider type), or a literal phone number / Telegram chat ID; provider is optional — omit it and the skill uses the one enabled messaging provider automatically, only asking (or erroring) if none or more than one is enabled. For recipientType 'user': recipient is an application-user name, resolved by name search; provider is optional — omit it to use that user's preferred paired channel. If the name search finds more than one match, the skill returns the candidate names instead of guessing — ask the user which one they meant and call the skill again with a more specific name.

parameters.name: recipientType
parameters.description: Who to send to: 'client' (default) for a Klacks client, or 'user' for an application user (login account).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The messaging provider name (e.g., telegram, whatsapp). Optional for both recipientType 'client' and 'user' — for 'client', omitting it uses the single enabled provider automatically (the skill only asks when none or more than one is enabled); for 'user', omitting it uses that user's preferred paired channel.

parameters.name: recipient
parameters.description: Recipient identifier. For recipientType 'client': 'mir' / 'ich' / 'me' / 'myself' to send to the Klacks owner — the skill looks up the Owner-Messenger jsonb setting and resolves the requested provider type to a chat ID / phone. Otherwise a contact name (e.g. 'Max Muster') which is resolved against the Klacks Mitarbeiter Messenger tab for the requested provider type, or a literal phone number / Telegram chat ID that is sent through unchanged. For recipientType 'user': an application-user name, resolved by name search.

name: read_messages
description: Read recent messages from messaging providers. Shows incoming and outgoing messages with sender, content, and timestamp.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter by provider name (e.g., telegram, whatsapp)

parameters.name: sender
parameters.description: Filter by sender phone number or ID

name: list_messaging_providers
description: List all configured messaging providers with their name, type, and enabled status.
